# Curly Tales

> > Curly Tales is India's leading food, travel, and lifestyle platform featuring restaurant reviews, weekend getaways, and experiential guides across Mumbai, Delhi, and beyond.

Founded by travel and food content creators including Kamiya Jani, Curly Tales covers everything from street food and fine dining to luxury staycations and international travel destinations. The platform specializes in honest restaurant reviews, unique travel experiences, and curated recommendations for urban explorers and food enthusiasts across India.

## Key Topics

- Mumbai restaurants
- Delhi dining scene
- Japanese cuisine
- Weekend getaways
- Restaurant reviews
- Travel destinations
- Luxury staycations
- Street food culture
- Fusion cuisine
- Brunch spots
- International travel
- Food festivals
- Heritage properties
- Lifestyle experiences

## Mumbai Restaurant Reviews

- [Pa Pa Ya Colaba is a sushi lover's delight. Try it out now](https://curlytales.com/pa-pa-ya-colaba-yas-please): Zorawar Kalra's Pa Pa Ya Japanese & pan-Asian restaurant in Colaba
- [masque restaurant review and rating eat at masque in mahalaxmi](https://curlytales.com/masque-restaurant-review): Farm-to-table fine dining review of Masque in Mumbai's Mahalaxmi
- [Love Maggi? Head To Hungry Head In Powai & Ghatkopar For An All Maggi Menu](https://curlytales.com/love-maggi-head-to-hungry-head-in-powai-ghatkopar-for-an-all-maggi-menu): Hungry Head in Powai & Ghatkopar serves specialty Maggi menu items
- [Hard Rock Cafe: Go Wild With Nachos!](https://curlytales.com/nachos-at-hard-rock-cafe): Hard Rock Cafe's Nacho Gone Wild festival with 8 fusion variations
- [5 World-Famous Finger Foods And Where To Find Them In Mumbai](https://curlytales.com/5-delicious-finger-food-around-the-world): Guide to international finger foods available in Mumbai restaurants
- [Monkey Bar Introduces 'Breakfirst' Every Sunday!](https://curlytales.com/monkey-bar-introduces-breakfirst-every-sunday): Monkey Bar Khar's Sunday Breakfirst brunch menu and events
